Reinforced_Beetle_Carapace_Chassis.description: This reinforced beetle carapace chassis is a formidable, heavy-duty core component, offering unparalleled protection with its thick, chitinous armor that grants a natural shield against most attacks, though at the cost of agility and nimbleness, making it a steadfast cornerstone for those seeking resilience and defensive prowess.

Segmented_Centipede_Exoskeleton_Core.description: The Segmented Centipede Exoskeleton Core is a resilient and agile insectoid chassis, its sleek, segmented armor granting unparalleled dexterity and a measure of endurance, while secreting a toxic poison that can be dispersed as a choking cloud or used defensively to ward off attackers.

Lightweight_Locust_Swarm_Frame.description: This delicate yet resilient insectoid frame, crafted from the finest lightweight chitin, allows for unparalleled agility and nimble flight, granting its bearer the grace and speed of a locust swarm while slightly compromising brute strength.

Acidic_Bombardier_Beetle_Chassis.description: This insectoid chassis, with a robust exoskeleton and a bulbous abdomen brimming with caustic fluids, allows the user to walk with an imposing gait and unleash a corrosive poison cloud that engulfs enemies, reducing their defenses and morale.

Luminescent_Firefly_Abdomen_Core.description: Enveloped in a faint, ethereal glow, the Luminescent Firefly Abdomen Core pulsates with a mesmerizing rhythm, its bioluminescent patterns shifting and intertwining with arcane energies, enhancing the bearer's charisma and perception, while granting the abilities to emit blinding light and lure prey or foes with its enchanting radiance.

Burrowing_Mole_Cricket_Frame.description: The Burrowing Mole Cricket Frame is a robust insectoid chassis, characterized by its powerful limbs and compact, sturdy build, allowing it to both walk confidently on the surface and burrow swiftly beneath, enhancing its strength and resilience in the face of physical assaults.

Venomous_Scorpion_Tail_Chassis.description: This formidable tail, a twisted amalgamation of chitin and venom, serves as the core of a monstrous arachnid, enhancing its agility and strength while granting it the sinister abilities to inflict grievous bleeding wounds and unleash a choking cloud of poison.

Silk_Spinning_Weaver_Spider_Core.description: This Silk-Spinning Weaver Spider Core pulsates with an otherworldly energy, its intricate web of neural connections granting unparalleled agility and stealth, allowing the entity to traverse environments with uncanny ease and ensnare foes in a cocoon of silk and shadow.

Camouflaging_Stick_Insect_Frame.description: This slender, elongated frame mimics the appearance of a twig or leaf, granting its bearer unparalleled stealth as they blend seamlessly into their surroundings, while also endowing them with the ability to scale sheer surfaces and navigate through the densest foliage with eerie grace.

Parasitic_Wasp_Hive_Chassis.description: The Parasitic Wasp Hive Chassis is a sleek, organic construct that hums with the relentless energy of a thousand parasitic wasps, enhancing agility and resilience while granting the ability to perform acrobatic maneuvers in mid-air with unparalleled precision and speed.
